STAGE 1 — SCOPE AUDIT of the three proposals against the five scope clauses, using the frozen bundles.

FLOWCURV-RQ: (1) behaviour = per-item directed net-flow divergence phi_i=(in-out)/(in+out+1) from train-only T matrix, aggregated per codeword by transition mass; named and computed. (2) geometry = per-codeword Lorentz radial geodesic distance d=asinh(sqrt(kappa)u)/sqrt(kappa), kappa=rho_l^-2 exp(s_hat), acting at every RQ level in the argmin AND in the quantization/commitment term (E12/E13 PROPOSED match). (3) coupling: one distance is used for assignment and for the differentiable loss, one codebook tensor for assignment/residual/reconstruction — directly repairs the structural defect that killed the last round. kappa->0 gives the Euclidean limit, so a genuine geometry-off switch exists. (4) observables + both-off arms named, falsifier stated (recall <=0.0638 rejected). (5) spec has equations, safeguards (clip +/-1, clamps 0.1-10 rho^-2, std floor, rho floor 1e-3), cost (<2% wall clock, same shapes). => IN SCOPE.

GEOCAP-RQ: behaviour = popularity-adjusted directed transition salience b_i, soft per-(level,code) demand with EMA; geometry = Poincare geodesic distance + disk-area law inverse rho; offset -(rho_{l,k}-h) in the argmin; decoder/residual use exact chart image a_{l,k}. Self-consistency check I verified: with bhat normalised to mean 1 and A_0 defined as the area of the radius-h disk, rho=h exactly at mean demand, so the offset is automatically zero-mean (no hidden constant). IN SCOPE, but note (i) the curved distance enters ONLY the argmin — the loss (reconstruction+commitment+codebook) is unchanged, so the geodesic has no gradient path; the geometry is a discrete selection bias; (ii) the offset is independent of the item/residual (a per-codeword additive prior), and it is closed-loop on the model's own soft assignment.

geoflow-metric-rq: behaviour = uhat_i from row-normalised train transitions over detached embeddings; the anisotropic term is correctly <r-c_k,uhat_i>^2 via (a_i-b_ik)^2; geometry = lambda_k = 1 - min(z_k^2, 1-1/K) with z_k = ||c_k||/max_j||c_j||. Cost and switches present. IN SCOPE, but thinnest geometry: no distance/exp/log/geodesic is computed — the "curvature" is the scalar (1-z_k^2) multiplying an anisotropic penalty, and the ball radius is defined by the codebook's own max norm, which has no independent geometric anchor; the observed precedent [E6] tangent_successor_residual (direction-only assignment) landed at recall 0.05500 = baseline.

Still open: which placement the observed evidence best supports.

STAGE 2 — EVIDENCE GROUNDING for the ordering. What I read in the bundles (identical observed items in all three: E4-E11, with E1-E3 and E12-E13 PROPOSED).

Anchors used:
- [E6] width-20 beam survival on 57,439 test rows: l1_br 0.04671; l1_br_euclid 0.06207; l1_only 0.06233; resample 0.06363; successor_entropy 0.05122; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500; _v2 0.05463; tangent_successor_residual 0.05500. Read: (a) the largest recall levers observed are deep-level treatment / inference resampling, not first-level behaviour ranking; (b) two prior Stage-2 behaviour-geometry assignments (geodesic coarse, tangent residual) sit AT the 0.055 baseline, so behaviour-conditioned assignment geometry per se has not paid yet.
- [E7] teacher-forced NLL: l1_br T4=9.03 (catastrophic deep level) vs l1_br_euclid T1..T4 0.00/3.22/4.36/1.23. Read: differences live in levels 2-3 residual geometry; any mechanism that also perturbs the deep-level reconstruction gradient carries the T4=9.03 failure risk.
- [E8] first-level capacity ceiling: behavioural neighbour co-location 0.3106 at K=16 vs 0.0822 at K=256. Read: partition capacity/granularity demonstrably governs whether behavioural neighbours share a prefix — the strongest direct empirical anchor for a capacity/cell-size mechanism (GEOCAP), and an argument that coarsening deep cells can help prefix survival.
- [E9] cohort-profile signal (0.9291 positive vs 0.8871 negative; profile entropy 1.65 nats over 7.5 cohorts) and [E5] successor-entropy stratification (top-1 mass 0.4375 -> 0.0543, Spearman -0.973). Read: successor structure is real and stratifiable — supports successor-diversity/popularity-adjusted demand (GEOCAP) more than sink/source polarity, for which the bundle contains no measured statistic (E10 only gives mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526, edge_density 5.3266, 118315 edges — no in/out asymmetry).
- [E11] same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067. Read: first-level prefix signal is weak but non-null.

Placement reasoning:
1 FLOWCURV-RQ — only proposal whose curved distance is inside BOTH the argmin and the differentiable quantization/commitment term, so the encoder itself is reshaped and removal of either factor changes the gradient, not just the partition; kappa->0 is a clean flat limit; targets the level-2/3 residual geometry that E7 shows is where information dies; cheapest and most fully specified (safeguards, derived rho_l from measured residual median). Cost: its behaviour signal (net-flow polarity) has no measured support in the bundle beyond E10's sparse-graph aggregates.
2 GEOCAP-RQ — best anchored behaviour-to-capacity story via E8 (cell granularity, 0.3106 vs 0.0822) and internal RQ level economy (offset zero at mean demand, verified); keeps codebook, residual, decoder and commitment colour Euclidean so it is the least likely to reproduce E7's T4=9.03 deep-level blow-up. Demoted to 2 because the geodesic distance never enters the loss (selection-only coupling) and the item-independent additive offset plus self-referential EMA is exactly the "hubs swallow a level" mode flagged in E6/E11.
3 geoflow-metric-rq — closest to the already-measured null: tangent_successor_residual = 0.05500 (E6), geometry is a scalar (1-z_k^2) with no geodesic/exp/log computation and a ball radius defined by max codeword norm (no geometric anchor), so the strong "hyperbolic" claim rests on the thinnest computation of the three; its own hypothesis only aims "toward 0.065" with no falsifying recall threshold.

Cross-cutting objection: all three are Stage-2 quantizer-only levers while E6's two best numbers (resample 0.06363, l1_only 0.06233) come from deep-level/inference treatment, and one no-ablation, no-sweep, single-seed run against a 0.0555+/-0.0638 history cannot separate a mechanism effect of the required size from seed noise.

STAGE 3 — FINAL ANSWER (complete; this record stands on its own).

RANK: FLOWCURV-RQ | position=1 | reason=Only proposal that puts the curved distance inside both the argmin and the differentiable quantization/commitment term on one shared codebook (E12/E13), with a clean flat kappa->0 geometry-off limit, so it attacks the level-2/3 residual geometry where E7 shows information dies (l1_br_euclid T2/T3 NLL 3.22/4.36, l1_br T4=9.03) instead of only re-ranking a fixed partition; caveat: its net-flow polarity signal has no measured support in the bundle (E10 gives only mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526 / edge_density 5.3266, no in/out asymmetry).
RANK: GEOCAP-RQ | position=2 | reason=Best behaviour-to-capacity grounding in the observed evidence: E8 shows partition granularity alone decides behavioural neighbour co-location (0.3106 at K=16 vs 0.0822 at K=256), matching its area-law cell sizing, and its radius law is internally consistent (rho=h at mean demand bhat=1, so the offset is zero-mean by construction, verified); demoted because the Poincare distance enters only the argmin with the loss left unchanged (selection-only coupling) and the item-independent additive offset plus self-referential EMA is exactly the hub-swallows-a-level mode behind E6's l1_br 0.04671 and E11's weak 0.0907 same-prefix rate.
RANK: geoflow-metric-rq | position=3 | reason=Closest to an already-measured null: the direction-only assignment precedent tangent_successor_residual scores 0.05500 in E6, equal to the 0.0555 baseline, and its curvature reduces to the scalar (1-z_k^2) with a ball boundary defined by the codebook's own max norm, so no geodesic/exp/log computation anchors the hyperbolic claim; its own hypothesis only aims "toward 0.065" and names no falsifying recall threshold.

Objection (string): All three are Stage-2 quantizer-only levers, but the two highest numbers in the frozen evidence come from deep-level/inference treatment rather than assignment geometry (resample 0.06363, l1_only 0.06233) while both prior behaviour-geometry assignments landed at the 0.055 baseline (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500), and with one 3000-epoch run, no ablation arm, no sweep and no seed repetition against a 0.0555-to-0.0638 historical spread, no candidate can demonstrate that a >0.065 result is a coupling effect rather than seed noise; the ranking above therefore orders by mechanism integrity and evidentiary grounding, not by demonstrated ability to clear 0.065.
